data.title: LG levels up the gaming industry with new monitors
data.description: BANGKOK, Oct 8, 2026 – LG Electronics (Thailand) Co, Ltd, reinforcing its position as a global leader in monitor innovation, has officially announced the launch and availability of two new flagship models in the LG UltraGear™ lineup. Packed with world-class technologies engineered to deliver unparalleled gaming and user experience, the new monitors feature ultra-fast speeds tailored for competitive esports, alongside AI-powered visuals and immersive audio on expansive OLED displays. Gamers can now experience and own these latest monitors starting today.

data.title: Huawei Thailand wins two HR Asia awards
data.description: Bangkok, 7 October 2026 – Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. has been recognized at the HR Asia Awards 2026 , receiving two prestigious awards, HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026 and HR Asia Tech Empowerment Awards 2026 , and marking the fourth consecutive year that Huawei Thailand has received recognition from the HR Asia Awards.

data.title: Trump rules out new Iran attack before US midterm elections
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump on Thursday ruled out attacking Iran before the US midterm elections on Nov 3, saying Washington was holding "productive discussions" with Tehran.

data.title: Malaysia closes schools in several states, territories due to haze
data.description: KUALA ​LUMPUR - ⁠Schools ⁠in several Malaysian states ​as well as its federal and administrative capitals will ​be closed on Friday, ‌the Education Ministry said, after smoky haze caused by forest fires in neighbouring Indonesia pushed air pollution to unhealthy levels.

data.title: Working groups to draw up 'open government' plans
data.description: Four working groups will develop proposals on corruption, environmental problems, public participation and access to justice as Thailand works on its next national action plan for open government.

data.title: Debt trapping younger Thais
data.description: Young Thais are entering debt at increasingly early ages, gaining access to credit cards, instalment plans and digital financial services before many have developed the financial discipline to manage them.

data.title: City Hall to clean up Rom Klao estate 'in 4-5 days'
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has teamed up with the Defence Ministry to clean up Rom Klao Housing Estate in Lat Krabang district within four to five days as authorities step up drainage efforts in 80 communities still affected by flooding.

data.title: Govt defends  transfer of district chief
data.description: Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee has defended the transfer of Ban Sang district chief Setthawut Wonglerwut, saying the decision was based on reports from provincial officials and local leaders rather than political pressure.

data.title: BOT tightens checks on foreign-currency inflows and gold transactions
data.description: The Bank of Thailand now requires source documents for specified foreign-currency inflows of US$200,000 or more, with gold transactions checked at all values.
